name: Sergios-Orestis Kolokotronis
bio: Sergios holds a PhD in Ecology and Evolutionary Biology from Columbia University and had a [postdoc](https://research.amnh.org/users/koloko) in the AMNH Sackler Institute for Comparative Genomics and Center for Conservation Genetics, where he coordinated the DNA Barcoding Initiative for Conservation. He created and maintained the lab website from 2006 until 2008.
